No universal working-day duration or OIR threshold, telemetry collector, runner or duplicate organic qualifier is introduced.
Vendor documentation initially supports pinned repository snapshots and same-vendor integration repositories; unsupported unpinned official-site citations remain unresolved rather than adopted.
Operational client integration, restart-window fixes, fresh-session smokes and daily measurement belong to their designated owners; this lane changes no client configuration or runtime.
Local state-readback classes remain local; native functional smoke and organic-owner qualification remain distinct. Synthetic/planning evidence cannot qualify completed daily adoption.
All existing 79 roles stay pending with null census and empty selections; no native readiness figure changes. Independent exact-head review is pending.

Daily qualification also needs a known canonical native-client emitter source pin. Missing or unmapped client source identity remains non-adopted; this carrier adds no unpinned official-site/version-mapping parser.
